section.title: Selected work
section.subtitle: Production backends, payment rails, operational tooling and quant systems I have designed, built and run.

projects.title: Real-time liquidity and reconciliation system
projects.summary: A real-time system that keeps wallets, blockchain accounts and payment providers in sync so withdrawals go through.
projects.problem: [CHECK] Withdrawals failed when balances drifted out of sync across wallets, blockchain accounts and payment providers.
projects.built: I designed a real-time liquidity and reconciliation system across all three, with automated webhook and ledger checks.
projects.result: Failed customer withdrawals dropped to under 0.1%.

diagram.caption: Real-time balance checks, ledger matching and withdrawal settlement flow

projects.title: Cross-chain blockchain infrastructure
projects.summary: Rust infrastructure for signing, routing and confirming transactions across Stellar, Solana, Ethereum and TRON.
projects.problem: [CHECK] Cross-chain transactions needed reliable signing, routing and finality checks that would not drop transfers under load.
projects.built: I built and maintained Rust-based blockchain infrastructure covering wallets, signing and on-chain monitoring across four chains.
projects.result: 99.9% uptime while processing over $1M in cross-chain transactions in 8 months.

diagram.caption: Cross-chain transaction signing, routing and finality verification flow

projects.title: Agent Banking backend
projects.summary: A backend feature that let local agents handle customer transactions during a liquidity shortage.
projects.problem: A liquidity shortage made it hard to complete customer transactions through standard payment rails alone.
projects.built: I designed and launched an Agent Banking backend so local agents could facilitate customer transactions.
projects.result: Transactions kept moving through the shortage, and the business gained a new transaction-based revenue channel.

diagram.caption: Agent-assisted customer transaction routing and commission settlement flow

projects.title: Pan-African fiat on/off-ramp and payment APIs
projects.summary: Payment APIs connecting Flutterwave, Link and Bridge for fiat on and off-ramps in five African countries.
projects.problem: [CHECK] Fiat ramps across five countries meant combining several payment providers, each with different webhooks and settlement flows.
projects.built: I built backend services and integrations for Flutterwave, Link and Bridge, plus card and wallet funding flows.
projects.result: On and off-ramps live in five countries, serving 4,000+ users with sub-200ms API responses.

diagram.caption: Multi-provider fiat on/off-ramp request and webhook settlement pipeline

projects.title: Crypto infrastructure telemetry dashboard
projects.summary: An internal dashboard showing live transaction volume and infrastructure activity across blockchain networks.
projects.problem: [CHECK] Stakeholders needed live visibility into transaction volume without digging through logs or production databases.
projects.built: I built a dashboard that aggregates on-chain transaction volume and network activity across supported chains.
projects.result: Stakeholders gained a clear, real-time view of cross-chain activity for daily operations.

diagram.caption: On-chain indexer aggregation and live stakeholder telemetry readout

projects.title: ClickHouse market data pipeline and exchange fallback
projects.summary: A ClickHouse pipeline for 5+ months of market data, with price feeds that fall back across four exchanges.
projects.problem: [CHECK] Strategy testing needed months of historical data and live price feeds that survive one exchange going down.
projects.built: I synchronised 5+ months of Forex and crypto data into ClickHouse and built a fallback layer across Coinbase, Kraken, Bitfinex and Binance.
projects.result: Faster strategy validation and parameter optimisation, with more resilient live market data.

diagram.caption: Multi-exchange market feed ingestion, failover routing and ClickHouse storage

projects.title: Weighted probability engine and risk controls
projects.summary: A probability engine and risk filters for an autonomous prediction-market arbitrage system.
projects.problem: [CHECK] Short-lived arbitrage edges needed accurate real-time probability estimates and protection against price wicks and late reversals.
projects.built: I co-developed the arbitrage system, built a weighted probability engine, and added wick-detection and end-of-hour stop-loss rules.
projects.result: Simulated win rate rose from 91% to 95%, with a 190% ROI in March 2026 in simulated and live environments.

diagram.caption: Real-time probability estimation, wick filtering and autonomous execution
